{{Infobox D&D |image = Oyster (Giant Oyster, open).png |release = [[14 December]] [[2015]] |update = Beneath Cursed Tides Quest - Christmas Quest Pt 3 |areas = [[Tutorial Island]] |members = Yes, but non-members can gain [[Fishing]] experience |ironmen = yes |frequency = Monthly |reset = Hard |skills = [[Fishing]], [[Farming]] |currency = None |leagueRegion = Misthalin & Asgarnia }} The '''Giant Oyster''' is a monthly [[Distraction and Diversion]] within the [[sunken Tutorial Island]] that is accessible upon completion of [[Beneath Cursed Tides]]. Players can collect and catch items to feed to the [[Oyster (Giant Oyster)|oyster]], receiving [[Fishing]] and [[Farming]] experience from doing so. Once fed, the Giant Oyster will close its mouth, preventing further feedings. The following month after being fed, the Giant Oyster can be checked, opening to reveal treasure inside for the player to collect. Players can leave the island by teleporting away or by leaving to the surface through the bubbles in the building north-east of the seaweed patch (this is the original building that the player started in when creating a character in Tutorial Island). Free-to-play players may only gain Fishing experience from fishing [[sea cucumber]], but will not receive any rewards. [[Free-to-play]] players cannot feed or interact with the oyster. The Giant Oyster can be reset once per month with a [[Distraction & Diversion reset token (monthly)|monthly D&D token]]. [[Urns]] and [[advanced pulse core]]s do not work on the Fishing and Farming experience received from this event. Neither do the (elite) skilling outfits, like the [[fury shark outfit]] and the [[farmer's outfit]]. {{monthly reset countdown}} ==Getting started== [[File:Oyster (Giant Oyster, closed).png|right|thumb|150px|A Giant Oyster that has been fed]] To begin feeding the Giant Oyster, speak to [[Wizard Myrtle]], found in front of the entrance to [[Wizards' Tower]]. She will let you dive to Tutorial Island. If the Oyster is already closed (from feeding the previous month) the player will not receive the [[sea cucumber]] or [[delicious seaweed]] items, but will still gain experience from the Fishing and Farming activity. If the player gains the maximum monthly experience from these activities without receiving the items, they must then loot the Oyster before re-attempting to fish and/or pick seaweed. Once the Oyster is open, they can then harvest the missing item(s), but will not receive any additional experience for the action. It is not known if this is a bug; however, there is no effect in terms of experience or rewards if the player forgets to loot the Oyster first and has to re-attempt the Farming or Fishing activity. Players with 200 million experience in Farming and/or Fishing, will be unable to interact with either resource if the oyster is already closed, and will receive both a pop up, and a message in their chat box, stating they already have 200 million experience in the relevant skill. After feeding the Oyster the delicious seaweed and sea cucumber, the Oyster will close. ==Feeding== The player must obtain a [[sea cucumber]] and [[delicious seaweed]] and feed these to the Oyster, which is found in the cooking area of Tutorial Island. [[Bonus experience]] is not gained when harvesting; [[experience-boosting set]]s will not boost experience gains either. Players with 200 million experience in Fishing and/or Farming will receive the item instantly after clicking on the respective skilling spot. ===Sea cucumber=== [[File:Fishing spot (Tutorial Island).png|right|thumb|The Fishing spot]] A [[sea cucumber]] can be fished from the fishing spots found directly west of the Giant Oyster. When attempting to fish, the player will gain [[Fishing]] experience 30 times before finally catching a sea cucumber. The amount of Fishing experience gained depends on the player's Fishing level. The Fishing level can be boosted, and the player will receive the rate based on the boosted level (i.e. a boost from 94 to 99 will give 6,966 experience each harvest). As the boost wears away, the experience rate will as well. The amount of Fishing experience gained from harvesting the cucumber is roughly three times of the amount of Farming experience gained from harvesting the delicious seaweed. {| style="text-align:center;" |

|} ===Delicious seaweed=== [[File:Tasty looking seaweed.png|right|thumb|The tasty looking seaweed patch]] [[Delicious seaweed]] can be harvested from the [[tasty looking seaweed]] patch north of the Oyster, near the [[large Jellyfish]]. When attempting to harvest from the seaweed patch, the player will gain Farming experience 30 times before finally harvesting delicious seaweed. The amount of Farming experience gained depends on the player's Farming level. The Farming level can be boosted, and the player will receive the rate based on the boosted level (e.g. a boost from 94 to 99 will give 2,322 experience each harvest). As the boost wears away, the experience rate will as well. The amount of Farming experience gained from harvesting the seaweed is roughly one-third of the amount of Fishing experience gained from harvesting a sea cucumber. {| style="text-align:center;" |

|} ==Rewards== {{Main|Treasure Trails/Rewards}} [[File:Giant oyster example loot.png|thumb|right|An example of the rewards obtained by looting the Oyster.]] At the monthly reset, the closed Oyster can be opened. Looting the Oyster will reward the player with items from the [[Treasure trail#Rewards|Treasure Trail reward tables]]. The player's total level is used to determine which tables the player can roll on, such as easy/medium/hard, or hard/elite, and then chooses between them randomly. While the rewards mechanic is similar to completing a [[treasure trail]], the rewards ''cannot'' be re-rolled like those from a treasure trail [[clue scroll]]. This will take effect from February onwards. * {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (4 January 2016)|date=4 January 2016}} ** Fixed some typos on the Giant Oyster D&D tracker. * {{UL|type=update|update=Beneath Cursed Tides Quest - Christmas Quest Pt 3|date=14 December 2015}} ** Added to game. }} ==Trivia== * On [[11 January]] [[2016]], a bug allowed players to repeatedly reset the oyster. This was patched within the hour. Players who abused the bug were banned or rolled-back, based on how much they abused the glitch. * It's highly recommended if intending on using a Luck of the Dwarves ring to loot the Oyster before looting the seaweed and fishing at the fishing spot. Leaving the underwater area and coming back will lock the Oyster chest until the next reset, regardless if it was looted or not. *Bonus experience and experience boosts used to apply to the Giant Oyster, prior to a hidden update on 11 April 2016. *Although called the "Giant Oyster", the model resembles a giant clam. *After the [[2 October]] [[2023]] patch, players with 200 million experience in the two relevant skills will receive the two oyster food items instantly after interacting with the skilling spots, ostensibly to save those players time. The same patch prevents said players from skilling with the spots while the oyster is already closed, stating that they already have 200 million experience in that skill. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Beneath Cursed Tides}} {{Dnd}} [[Category:Repeatable events]] [[pt:Ostra Gigante]]
